artworks.title: Jan Six
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting by a windowsill, holding a document and looking slightly to the right. The person has their eyes slightly closed and appears calm. They are wearing 17th-century attire, including a doublet, wide collar, and knee-length breeches. The background includes heavy drapery curtains around the window, daylight filtering through, and a table with a hat and sword. The room has textured walls, a table, and a chair with a flat surface.

artworks.title: Jan Asselijn
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.5 x 17 cm (8 7/16 x 6 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body in a seated position. He is facing slightly to his left with a long face, pronounced cheekbones, a pointed nose, and a small mustache. His hair curls down to his shoulders, and he wears a tall, wide-brimmed hat, a dark coat, and a white shirt. His right arm rests on a surface where books or papers are stacked. The background is plain and textured.

artworks.title: Jan Asselijn
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man seated and facing slightly to the left. His upper body is visible from the waist up. The man wears a broad-brimmed hat and long, curly hair. He has a mustache, a direct gaze, and wears a dark garment with a lighter collar and cuffs. His left arm rests on a ledge with documents or books. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Jan Cornelisz. Sylvius
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 28.1 x 19.3 cm (11 1/16 x 7 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man shown from the waist up, seated, and facing slightly to the left. He has a full beard, short hair mostly covered by a cap, and a serious expression. He is wearing a coat with fur trim, a light-colored shirt with a large, frilled collar, and is holding a book in one hand, which rests on the table before him. His other hand is extended slightly forward with the palm up. There is an oval frame around him with inscriptions, and the background is plain with shading. At the bottom, there are columns of text.

artworks.title: Nude Man Seated and Nude Man Standing,  with a Woman and Baby in the Background
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.7 x 12.8 cm (7 3/4 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching with two figures in the foreground. The seated figure is reclined with legs stretched out and leaning back on one arm. The standing figure is behind them, slightly leaning forward and resting one hand on a cushion or rock. Both have long, unkempt hair and expressive facial features. They wear draped clothing. In the background, there are a few more individuals, including a bald person and someone seated, partially cloaked or wrapped in fabric. The setting suggests an interior with various structures and objects. The style is sketch-like, with hatching and cross-hatching providing texture and depth.

artworks.title: Nude Man Seated before a Curtain
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring a full view of a seated nude male figure. The person is sitting with a slouched posture, leaning slightly back, with his hands resting loosely joined in his lap. His head is tilted to the side, and he has a contemplative expression on his face. His facial features include prominent cheekbones, a defined nose, and full lips, with wavy, shoulder-length hair framing his face. The background consists of closely spaced and cross-hatched lines typical of etching. The scene is devoid of any additional objects or adornments, with a simple platform or ledge on which the figure is seated. The signature "Rembrandt f. 1646" is etched at the bottom, indicating the artist and the year.

artworks.title: Cottages and Farm Buildings with a Man Sketching
artworks.description: The image is a detailed etching of a thatched-roof cottage with trees nearby. The horizon is low, with the sky occupying much of the background. A figure wearing a hat is seated close to us, looking at the cottage. The etching uses fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth, especially in the thatched roof and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying densities of black ink lines against a light background. In the distance, the landscape opens up, suggesting a flat terrain beyond the building.

artworks.title: Cottage beside a Canal
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level perspective of a rural landscape. A thatched-roof cottage and trees are on the left side, with a townscape and church spire in the distance on the right. The artist used detailed pen strokes to create texture and lines depicting vegetation and architecture. The color palette is monochromatic with dark and light shades on beige paper.

artworks.title: The Omval
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.7 × 22.9 cm (7 3/8 × 9 in.)
artworks.description: This image depicts a person walking along the edge of a river bank. In the background, there are buildings and a windmill. The illustration is done in an etching style with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of sepia and dark gray. The sky is clear with subtle hints of clouds.

artworks.title: Six's Bridge
artworks.description: This print shows a landscape with a flat perspective, featuring a countryside scene with a low bridge. The horizon is low, emphasizing the blank sky above. In the distance, there are trees and some low buildings, including a church spire. On the right, a sailboat floats on a low body of water. In the center of the print, there is a detailed wooden bridge with two abstract people in hats standing by the railing, looking towards the boat on the right. The print has been done in thin black lines on off-white paper.

artworks.title: The Three Trees
artworks.artist: William Byron after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: Printed with deep, black shadows and swirling or straight lines on pale tan-colored paper, three trees stand on a grassy bank alongside a body of water, probably a river or canal, in this horizontal etching, engraving, and drypoint. The grassy bank reaches almost two-thirds of the way across the composition from the right edge. At least two people, a horse-drawn wagon or carriage filled with more people, and a town, all minuscule in scale, are tucked under or beyond the trees. The face of the bank directly opposite us is dark in shadow and the details of plants and the waterline are hard to make out. The bank tapers down so the distant horizon, which comes about a third of the way up the composition, stretches across the left half of the print. One person sits and one stands, fishing, by the water in the lower left corner. People work and cows stand or lie in the flat field beyond the water, and buildings and windmills created with a few strokes of the burin or etching needle are tiny in the far distance. The deeply shaded three trees are outlined starkly against the white sky. Dark clouds pour across the top of the sheet and enter along the left edge, and diagonal lines across the top left corner suggests falling rain. The artist signed and dated the print among grasses in the lower left corner of the printed image: “Rembrandt f. 1643.”

artworks.title: The Hog
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 x 18.1 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pig and some figures in the background. The drawing features a large pig in the foreground, detailed with etching lines to emphasize its physical features. In the background, there are roughly sketched figures that appear to be engaged with the scene. The composition suggests a pastoral moment, possibly related to farm life. Line and shadowing techniques are used to add depth and texture to the subjects.

artworks.title: Cottage with a White Paling
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated point. The horizon is in the center with a windmill and trees in the distance. The etching technique uses fine lines to create detailed textures for the trees, fence, and hills. The color palette is sepia. In the foreground, there is water with ducks, and to the right, there is a grassy area with trees, foliage, and a fence. A path leads to the right where a cart is seen near some trees.

artworks.title: Peter and John Healing the Cripple at the Gate of the Temple
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with architectural elements and a group of individuals in a marketplace or public setting. The line work shows a bustling environment filled with people engaged in various activities. In the foreground, a figure is seated on the ground with items displayed before them. The backdrop features grand buildings with columns, arches, and banners or tapestries, giving the impression of an ancient or historic city square. The composition creates depth, leading the eye from the foreground to the background. The artist's use of light and shadow adds dynamism to the scene.

artworks.title: Peter and John Healing the Cripple at the Gate of the Temple
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural setting with a central figure approaching or interacting with a seated figure. The drawing displays intricate details of a classical architectural space featuring large columns and possibly a rotunda in the background. There are multiple other figures in the scene, some observing and others engaged in various activities. In the foreground, a draped figure appears to be addressing or extending something to a seated figure holding a bowl. The use of shading and fine lines creates a rich texture and depth, emphasizing the voluminous drapery of the figures and the grandeur of the architectural backdrop. The figures in the background, along a curved path, suggest a procession or gathering.

artworks.title: Lieven Willemsz van Coppenol: the Larger Plate
artworks.description: This print shows a portrait of an older man with his body turned to the right and his face turned towards us. He has pale skin, a round face, a high forehead, a thin mustache, and receding white hair under a cap. He wears a dark, buttoned garment with a stiff white collar. The background is comprised of dark, crosshatched lines surrounded by a border of off-white paper.

artworks.title: Woman at the Bath with a Hat beside Her
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman in profile, facing to the left. She is on a piece of furniture resembling a bed, with her head turned slightly to the left. She appears to have a simple hairstyle, with her hair pulled back neatly. Her body is mostly unclothed, and she holds a piece of cloth over her legs with her right hand. There are no visible pieces of jewelry. In the background, there is a dark shadowy area, suggesting furniture. The lighting is brighter behind her head, creating contrast with the darker tones around her.

artworks.title: Woman Sitting Half Dressed beside a Stove
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman, partially uncovered in the upper body, with her lower body covered in a dark textured cloth. She is on the edge of a bed or seat, leaning slightly to her right, with her head turned to the left. Her hair is pulled back, revealing her facial features. Across her waist is a light-colored fabric, with one bare hand resting on it. One foot is visible. In the background is a textured, shadowed backdrop with an architectural element, possibly a column with a relief pattern. The room is dimly lit.

artworks.title: Saint Francis beneath a Tree Praying
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure in a natural landscape. The image shows a person kneeling at the base of a large tree. The tree has a twisted trunk with a dense canopy creating light and shadow. In the background, there is a structure with a small cross on top. The drawing style includes detailed cross-hatching and an emphasis on light and shadow.

artworks.title: Abraham Francen
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man holding a large open book or document, with a decorated artwork depicting a religious scene in the background. Various objects are visible around the room, and a window on the right side sheds light into the dimly lit space.

artworks.title: Abraham Francen
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting in a chair, seen in a side profile facing to the right. He is holding a piece of paper. The man has medium-length wavy hair, a mustache, and a prominent nose. He wears a garment with intricate designs and a collared shirt underneath. There is a large book on a table beside him and a multi-paneled artwork or altarpiece in the background. The setting includes a window with foliage or trees visible outside, providing natural light inside.

artworks.title: Jacob Haaringh (Young Haaringh) (Pieter Haaringh)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.8 x 15 cm (7 13/16 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays an illustration of a person from the waist up, seated and slightly turned towards their right. Their left hand rests on an unseen surface while their right hand is partially visible on their lap. The person has a serious expression with deep-set eyes, prominent eyebrows, a shadowed nose, and closely set lips. Their shoulder-length hair is wavy and light-colored. They are wearing a dark, buttoned garment with a white collar and cuffs, and holding a hat across their lap. The background is dark with an indistinct window on the right featuring ornate, vertical mullions allowing light into the dimly lit space.

artworks.title: Abraham Entertaining the Angels
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: Printed with delicate lines or heavy shading on cream-white paper, two elderly men and two others with wings sit on or stand near a cloth laid with food just in front of the open, deeply shadowed doorway of a house in this vertical etching and drypoint. The men and angels take up the lower third of the composition. One angel with a beard and long hair pulled back under a band sits facing our right in profile along the left edge of the print. Next is a man with a chest-length white beard, a long headdress, and a lined face. He holds the foot of a shallow chalice in one hand and gestures to an oval tray holding objects, presumably bread, on the cloth. The next person also has a beard and wings, and the fourth, near the right edge of the print, stands next to the cloth so he is visible from the waist up. His face is also heavily lined, and he has a long white beard and a fringe of bushy hair around a balding head. One hand rests on a long-necked ewer as he stoops slightly toward the cloth. The arched doorway stands open to the left, behind the first angel and man. A person peeks around the edge of the door from deep shadows. Heavy veils drape over the head and down the sides of the face and neck, and that person holds one hand up to their chest. A child clamors onto the top surface of a low wall just outside the doorway, which presumably encloses a stoop or landing. Trees fill most of the background in the right half. The artist signed and dated the plate, barely legible in the shadows, “Rembrandt f. 1656.”

artworks.title: Abraham's Sacrifice
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.7 x 13.4 cm (6 3/16 x 5 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing two figures and an altar. The image features a figure with a long beard holding a knife and another figure, possibly an angelic being with wings, leaning in close. They are surrounded by dramatic elements, including a sacrificial altar with a cross-like structure and a ram in the background. The intricate use of lines and cross-hatching techniques adds a dynamic and textured quality to the composition.
